_about: The official iPGRS grievance form (Praja Seve Department portal, 3 steps), as the contract every intake door fills. Screenshots: docs/ipgrs_form/. Required = the portal marks it with *; rules = what the portal enforces.

fields.label: Grievance description (own words)
fields.rule: 25 to 250 words; English or Kannada letters, numbers, spaces, commas and periods only; exact place (street, landmark, door number); since when; no Aadhaar, bank or card numbers

fields.label: Attachment
fields.rule: PDF, PNG or JPG; all files together at most 30 MB

fields.label: Taluk
fields.rule: from the taluks of that district

fields.label: Village → Gram Panchayat
fields.rule: from the GPs of that taluk; needed for GP-level officers (PDO)

fields.label: Address
fields.rule: where the problem is (map pin or text)

fields.label: Line department
fields.rule: from the official master, under the department

fields.label: Service
fields.rule: from the official master, under the line department

fields.label: Grievance name
fields.rule: from the official master, under the service

fields.label: Complainant name
fields.rule: as written; not provided is accepted for a paper letter

fields.label: Mobile number
fields.rule: 10 digits, Indian mobile; not provided is accepted for a paper letter

fields.label: Addressed to
fields.rule: the office or officer the letter names
